boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-cost SMU activities with direct university evidence of free access or admission.

cards.title: Browse Spanish art at the Meadows Museum
cards.subtitle: 5900 Bishop Blvd., SMU campus
cards.notes: Bring your current SMU ID and take a self-paced gallery lap, then pause with a friend to compare one work you each noticed.
cards.short_summary: A year-round, no-charge museum visit for SMU students.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU states that the Meadows Museum is open to SMU students free of charge year round.
cards.source_title: Dallas Resources | Meadows School of the Arts, SMU
cards.access_notes: SMU student access; use a current university ID.

cards.title: Join a Group Fitness yoga class
cards.subtitle: Dedman Center for Lifetime Sports
cards.notes: Register for a yoga session through Campus Recreation, arrive ready to move, and use the class as a low-key way to share activity time.
cards.short_summary: Yoga is among SMU Group Fitness offerings, and group exercise is free.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU Campus Recreation lists yoga among its group fitness classes and states that all classes are free.
cards.access_notes: Registration is encouraged; the page directs participants to the current class schedule.
